tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༈thar pa la skul ba'i rabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/thar pa la skul pa'i rabs zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal
༈thar pa la skul ba'i rabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/thar pa la skul pa'i rabs zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal

tei:div.tei:p: ༈ thar pa la skul ba'i rabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ thar pa la skul pa'i rabs zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshogs gnyis rnam 'phel yon tan rgyas pa'i gzhir/ /byang chub ljon tshogs me tog 'bras bkra zhing*/ /rnam grol zhi ba thar pa'i skyed mos tshal/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtha' yas 'gro la thugs rje'i spyan dbye ba'i/ /legs 'doms chos kyi rnga chen sgrogs pa'i don/ /deng 'dir thub pa'i gsung bzhin rab bsnyad kyi/ /thar par skul pa'i rabs zhes bya ba nyon/ /kye ma grogs dag srid gsum 'khor ba na/ /sdug bsngal me tshogs kyis gdung bde ba med/ / gcig nas gcig brgyud shing rta'i 'phang lo 'dra/ /de bas da res thar pa'i thabs shig 'tshal/ /khom ldan mi yi 'gro ba rnyed gyur cing*/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes dang mjal dus 'dir/ /bde 'gro thar pa'i skas la ma 'dzegs na/ / phyis nas dal 'byor lus rnyed shin tu dka'/ /dal dang 'byor pa'i mi lus ma thob na/ /sdig pa 'ba' zhig mngon par 'phel ba las/ /dge goms chos la spyod pa'i skabs mi rnyed/ /dam pa'i chos zhes sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /dam pa'i chos dang phrad par ma gyur na/ /sdig pa'i dbang gis 'og nas 'og tu 'gro/ / ngan song gnas nas thon par ma gyur na/ /snga ma'i sdug bsngal drag pos mnar bzhin du/ /phyi ma'i las ngan dpag med sogs pas na/ /mu mtha' med pa'i 'khor bar rtag tu 'khyams/ /mtha' med sdig pa'i rgya mtshor 'khyams dus 'dir/ /rang rang las kyi rba klong drag po 'khrugs/ /sdug bsngal gting mtha' dpag tu med pa las/ /las zad bar du yang yang brnag dgos so/ /rang gi las ngan 'khrul pa'i me tshogs la/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rjes dngos su gzhil dka' ste/ /sngon 'das sangs rgyas grangs med byon na yang */ /bdag cag da dung srid par 'khyams la ltos/ /de bas da lta dal 'byor thob dus 'dir/ / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med bsam byas nas/

/zhi ba rab bzang thar pa'i skyed tshal du/ /de ring nyid nas mngon phyogs 'bad par bya/ /da res zab mo'i chos la brtson byas na/ /tshe 'dir thar pa'i lam sna zin par nges/ /thar lam zin na bde nas bde bar 'gro/ /byang chub bde legs 'byor pa lag na 'dug /bde legs dbang gis ngan 'gror mi ltung zhing*/ /bde 'gro mtho ris 'jig rten mchog tu 'gro/ /der song nas ni dge la rab brtson zhing*/ / mngon mtho nges legs dga' ston bzang po myong*/ /dge bas thar pa'i lam bzang rin chen du/ /rgyal ba'i 'byor pa rmad byung mtha' yas bskrun/ /bde gshegs blta dang gtsang ma'i chos rab mnyan/ /zhing sbyangs 'phags pa'i dge 'dun mchog dang 'grogs/ /pad+mo can sogs dag pa'i 'jig rten du/ /pad+mo las skyes sems gtsang rnyog pa med/ /pad+mo ltar mdzes yon tan tshogs mang zhing*/ /pad+mo'i dpal sogs rgyal ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /de phyir blo dang ldan pa'i skye bo rnams/ /de ring nyid nas brtson pa'i go bgos te/ /dge goms yid la byed pa 'ba' zhig gis/ /thar lam 'dzegs la brtson pa brgya 'gyur rigs/ /da res srid las thar lam ma rnyed na/ /phyis nas zhi ba'i lam dang phrad pa dkon/ /zhi ba'i lam dang phrad par ma gyur na/ /mtha' med 'khor ba'i gnas las thar thabs med/ /da lta'i tsha grang bkres skom cung zad dang*/ /nad kyi sdug bsngal phra mo mi bzod na/ /sems dmyal yi dwags dud 'gro la sogs pa'i/ /sdug bsngal me tshogs 'bar ba bsran bzod dam/ /de bas da ltar rang dbang yod dus 'dir/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thar ba'i phan yon dang*/ /dge sdig blang dor tshogs gnyis sgrub la sogs/ /legs pa'i chos la nyin mtshan 'bad pa thon/ /dal 'byor thob kyang chos lam ma bsgrubs na/ /mi tshe chud zos yengs pa'i lam la zad/ /brgya la re 'ga'i mi lus rin chen 'di/ /da res thob dus stong log ma byed cig /tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam 'byor pa 'dra/

/sad pas stong ste ci yang med pa ltar/ /thams cad bor te gcig pur 'gro dus na/ /rjes su 'brang ba dge sdig gnyis las med/ /gnyen 'dun 'byor pas cis kyang mi stongs la/ /shi ba'i rjes su de dag 'gro ba med/ /bdag kyang phyir 'ong 'di ru mi ldog pas/ /tshe 'di'i bya bas bdag la ci byar yod/ /de bas 'jig rten 'khrul pa'i snang ba la/ /chags zhen dgag sgrub bden 'dzin kun spangs te/ / de ring nyid nas chos la brtson pa yis/ /dal 'byor don med chud zos ma song bya/ /da res 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis ni sdod pa'i gding ni ci la yod/ /tshe 'di'i nor rdzas bung ba'i sbrang rtsi 'dra/ /rang gis bsags kyang gzhan gyis spyod pa mang*/ /gnyen 'dun 'dza' bshes mgron po gnas mthun 'dra/ / lhan cig 'dus kyang so sor 'bral du nye/ /tshe srog mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra/ /da ltar yod kyang med pa myur du 'ong*/ /'chi bdag bdud ni so bya nya sdod 'dra/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bdag la glags skabs 'tshol/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam sad kha 'dra/ /mi rtag yun thung cis kyang dor nas 'gro/ /rgyu 'bras las rnams lus kyi grib ma 'dra/ /rtag par bdag gi rjes su 'brang bar byed/ /de bas blo dang ldan pa'i skye bo kun/ /de ring nyid nas thar lam sgrub par mdzod/ /'jig rten spyod pa dam pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /legs pa'i chos la rtag tu 'bad pa ste/ /snying nas mi rtag 'chi ba dran byas nas/ /skye bo dam pa rnams kyi rjes 'gro mdzod/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba gang dang gang yang rung*/ /byas pa thams cad don med sdug bsngal rgyu/ /'khrul pas byis pa bslu zhing snying po med/ /de bas thar pa byang chub sgrub par mdzod/ /bya ba btang na dam chos ngang gis 'grub/ /bya ba thongs na dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa 'jig /bya ba med na nyon mongs chu bo brgal/ /bya ba bral na rang sems ngang gis bde/ /gang la bsams kyang mi rtag snying po med/

/gang du bltas kyang 'pho zhing 'gyur ba'i chos/ /gang ltar dpyad kyang tshe 'di'i 'khrul snang la/ / gang gis ma chags skye bo mkhas pa yin/ /deng nas 'khor ba 'di la blo log ste/ /deng dus thar pa'i lam chen mchog zhugs nas/ /deng nyid brtson pas nyin mtshan 'da' byas na/ /deng 'dir sdug bsngal chu bo sgrol bar 'gyur/ /'gro ba 'khrul pa 'khrul pa'i dbang gis 'khrul/ /de las gang zhig gang las ldog pa gang*/ /dam chos bsgrub phyir sgrub la brtson pas sgrubs/ /mngon mtho nges legs nges par 'grub par nges/ /'gyur zhing mi rtag tshe 'di'i snang ba 'gyur/ /'gyur bar mi shes skye bo sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /'gyur bas yid 'byung thar pa 'dod par 'gyur/ /'gyur med don bsgoms srid las thar par 'gyur/ /rig dang ma rig khyad par so so las/ /las tshul tha dad bde sdug du mar snang*/ /snang srid snod bcud gzung 'dzin dbang gis 'khrul/ /'khrul par shes nas rtogs te mkhas par rigs/ /nyin mtshan kun tu dal 'byor snying por bya/ /cis kyang mi phan myur du 'gro rtsis bya/ /dam pa'i chos la deng nas brtson par bya/ /dad dang brtson 'grus bag yod bsten par bya/ /tshe 'di mi rtag myur du 'gro na yang*/ /tshu rol mthong bas rtag tu bden par zhen/ /tshig gu ma smin 'bras la chags pa bzhin/ /tsha zer nyon mongs gdung bas sred par zad/ /ma rig dbang gis 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ /me gsum dag gi sdug bsngal 'bar bas gdungs/ /mu mtha' med pa'i srid par 'khyams pa las/ /mi gang thar pa'i byang chub tshol ba mtshar/ /kye ma grogs dag dal 'byor rnyed gyur kyang*/ /sang dang 'jig rten phyi ma'i snang ba gnyis/ /sngon du gang 'byung bdag la cha yod dam/ / 'chi dus ci byed de dus su la re/ /de bas da lta 'chi'am gtol med kyi/ /ci 'grub dge la de ring brtun te bya/ /'tsho ba'i srog ni 'chi bdag bdud kyis 'phrog

/dar ba'i lang tsho dus kyi nad kyis 'phrog /'gyu ba'i dbugs ni 'chi bdag srin pos 'phrog /tshe 'di'i snang ba dus kyis gnyer te 'phrog /de bas nam 'chi nges pa ma mchis pas/ /yul dang gnas dang longs spyod la sogs dang*/ /phung po mi rtag sgyu ma'i lding gang la/ /sems shes su zhig sred pa 'phel ba bgyid/ /ma rig yang srid sdug bsngal chu bo la/ /nan gyis 'jug pa 'khor ba'i rang bzhin la/ /mkhas pa rnams ni rab tu rtogs pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten tshe 'di'i 'dzin pa btang bar mdzod/ /'jig rten 'di na rtag pa 'ga' med do/ /snod kyi 'jig rten gling bzhi ri rab dang*/ /nyi zla gza' skar 'dod lha'i skyed mos tshal/ /bsam gtan gnas dang bcas pa ma lus kun/ /me bdun chu gcig rlung gis 'thor ba'i tshe/ /skra rtse'i lhag rol tsam yang mi lus shing*/ /zhi gnas stong ste nam kha' gcig tu 'gyur/ /sos ka dbyar dang ston dus dgun dang dpy-id/ /lo zla tshes grangs skad cig 'gyur ba ste/ /kha sang de ring sang du 'pho ba bzhin/ /'di ltar sa steng 'jig rten ma lus na/ /dbyar dus rtswa shing me tog sman spos dang*/ /sems can phra mo ji snyed yod pa kun/ /dgun dus bskams te med par gyur la ltos/ /bcud kyi sems can mi rtag 'gyur ba ste/ /bdag gis dran dus sa steng mi rnams las/ /rgan rabs gzhon rabs skal mnyam du ma 'das/ /pha ma mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bran dang 'khor/ / khyim gang nang nas lhan cig tshogs rnams las/ /phal cher 'das shing mi rtag skyo ba 'phel/ /'ga' tsam yod kyang la la phyogs gzhan song*/ /rang nyid gcig pur da lta gnas la sogs/ /lo brgya'i khongs su 'das pa'i mi rnams kyis/ / rtag tu re bas nor dang rdzas bsags kyang*/ /bzhag nas song ste sha rus so sor 'bral/ /skye shi'i 'khor los gnas pa gcig kyang med/ /da lta'i sa steng 'gro ba phal cher yang*/ /bden par zhen nas nor dang rdzas la sred/

/'dod pas gdungs te gsog brun sna tshogs byed/ /rtag tu sdod snyam gcig gis gcig la 'tshe/ /chags sdang 'thab rtsod phyogs ris byed na yang*/ /dus kyis rnyings pa'i shing tog brul ba bzhin/ /snga phyir zad nas rtag pa 'ga' med de/ /lo brgya'i nang du gcig kyang lus mi 'gyur/ /tshal rnams me tog shing lo 'bo ba bzhin/ /swo dang skra sen sha rus so sor 'bral/ /tshol skyong 'dod pa du mas ci zhig bya/ /tshul 'dis sa steng 'gro ba phal cher bslus/ /de ltar mi rtag g.yo bar ma shes par/ /pha ma mdza' bshes gnyen dang nor gyi phyir/ /kun dang rtsod cing mi dge'i sdig rnams bsags/ /sdig de bdag nyid gcig pus myong ba las/ /de dag skal nod 'gyur ba 'ga' yang med/ /rnam smin phyi phyir 'brang ba'i khur thogs nas/ /bdag nyid gcig pur pha rol 'gro ba na/ /sdig pas bsags pa'i nor rnams gzhan gyis spyod/ /ser snas yid la 'phreng yang bya thabs med/ /gro zan gcig kyang khyer ba'i dbang med cing*/ /shul ring bgrod la 'grogs pa'i zla mi rnyed/ /chos med mi rnams de dus 'jigs pas 'dar/ / bar do'i 'phrang la gcig pur 'gro ba na/ /'khor 'dabs nang mi gcig kyang khrid dbang med/ /nor rdzas til 'bru gcig kyang khyer dbang med/ /kha drag dpung pa gcig kyang 'tshong dbang med/ /rang dbang gros mthun gcig kyang bya dbang med/ /bzo rig yon tan gcig kyang bskyang dbang med/ /bde dal cung zad gcig kyang rang dbang med/ /'khrul snang las kyi me long gsal bar 'gyur/ /kye ma dad ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams kun/ /da lta'i 'di bzhin gtan du mi 'ong bas/ /gnam sa 'gre ldog rang snang bskal pa 'khrug /de dus stongs pa'i dam chos byed re ran/ /ran pa bas kyang phyis par gyur pa tsam/ /da ltar nyid nas brtson pas 'bad 'tshal lo/ /lhan cig 'dus pa'i lus kyang so sor 'bral/ /mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun sred pas ci zhig bya/

/thams cad bor te gcig pur 'gro dus na/ /su nye su mdza' ji snyed yod gyur kyang*/ /bdag gi phyi bzhin 'gro ba gcig kyang med/ /gnyen bshes bu smad rnams kyis ci zhig byed/ /tshe 'dir bsags pa'i nor rdzas ci yod kyang*/ /bzhag nas 'gro dus phan pa gcig kyang med/ /de bas da lta sbyin pa'i gter du sbos/ /rjes su 'brang zhing 'phrog tu med par gsungs/ /nor rdzas sgyu ma yin gyi zhen pa skyungs/ / gnyen bshes 'ching ba yin gyi brtse gdung spongs/ /tshe 'di rmi lam yin gyi mi rtag sgoms/ /gzung 'dzin 'khor ba yin gyi rgyab tu bor/ /thams cad 'gyur yang da dung rtag tu re/ /mdza' dang mi mdza'i don phyir chags sdang byed/ / 'khrul snang dngos la blo stobs bden zhen 'cha'/ /byis pa'i bya ba 'di 'dras mngon par skyo/ /de bas da lta rang gi yo byad dang*/ /gnyen 'dun phyir yang sdig pa mi bsags shing*/ /don med 'tshe dang rtsod pa mi bya la/ /nye'am ring yang gzhan gyi sems mi dkrugs/ /kun la sems snyoms las su rung bar bya/ / des ni 'di phyir phan bde 'grub par 'gyur/ /do cig yod pas sang phod yod pa ltar/ /tshe 'dir yod pas phyi ma yod par 'gyur/ /sang phod lo dang tshe rabs phyi ma gnyis/ /gang snga yod pa'ang su la gtol med pas/ / sang phod don la so nam byed pa bzhin/ /phyi ma'i don du dam chos spyad par rigs/ /de ring do nub sang nyin mi 'chi zhes/ /re zhig brtags pas 'dug par rigs ma yin/ /glo bur rkyen gyis mi rtag g.yo bar 'gyur/ /de bas de ring nyid nas brtson par rigs/ /tshe 'di 'bab chu 'dra ste rtag pa med/ / lus 'di g.yar po 'dra ste yid brtan med/ /skye shi 'khor lo 'dra ste pha mtha' med/ /chos kun sgyu ma 'dra ste snying po med/ /rang gzhan dar rgud rmi lam snang ba 'dra/ /rtag tu yid brtan med do dam chos sgrubs/ /tshe 'di'i 'khrul snang byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/

/bslu zhing 'gyur ba yin no thar lam sgrubs/ /thams cad bden med par snang 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /gang la'ang yid brtan med kyis byang chub sgrubs/ /gzung 'dzin nyon mongs sprin tshogs 'khrigs pa 'dra/ /glo bur bag chags yin gyis sgrib pa sbyongs/ /'dus byas mi rtag bar snang glog dang 'dra/ /skad cig 'gyur ba yin no gtan srid zungs/ /'gro ba g.yo ba dus kyi shing 'dab bzhin/ /skyes kyang 'chi ba yin no chos la 'bad/ /rang bzhin 'gyur ba tshogs khang skye bo bzhin/ /'dus kyang 'bral ba yin no gdung sems spongs/ /rtag tu mi gnas rdzing bu'i 'bab chu 'dra/ /bsags kyang 'dzad pa yin no dngos zhen spongs/ / thams cad dar te me tog bkram pa bzhin/ /dar yang rgud pa yin no rlom sems spongs/ /da res thar lam byang chub ma bsgrubs na/ /gtan du 'khor ba'i gnas las thar mi 'gyur/ / sdug bsngal chu bo shin tu bgrod dka' bas/ /rang gzhan du khas gdung ba'i tshul la ltos/ /dal 'byor snying po ldan pa'i lus thob nas/ /thar lam ma zin don med 'da' byas na/ /'di las bslus pa bdag la gang zhig yod/ / phyi phyir sdug bsngal brgya phrag bzod nus sam/ /de bas rin chen gru bo rnyed dus 'dir/ /mngon mtho nges legs lam bzang srol btod de/ /dam chos ched du brtson 'grus brtsam par bya/ /des ni brgal dka'i srid mtsho sgrol bar 'gyur/ /srid las zhi bar mjug pa de dag gis/ /lha dang mi yi chos lugs la brten nas/ /rim gyis thar ba'i byang chub thob par gsungs/ /de phyir thog mar mngon mtho'i chos la bsten/ /de yang ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod pa/ /gnyis la brten nas yon tan bsgrub pa ste/ /dge ba bcu dang bsam gtan gzugs med bzhi/ /bag yod bsod nams cha mthun las rnams kyis/ /lha mi'i bde 'bras gong ma thob pas na/ /dge ba'i las rnams kun la bslab par bya/ /'di ltar rang gi mdza' bshes gnyen rnams dang*/

/nang mi grong mtshes gzhan yang 'gro rnams la/ /byams pa'i sems dang brtse ba'i mig gis blta/ /chos la bskul zhing sdig las ldog par bya/ /dkon mchog mchod cing phongs la sbyin pa dang*/ /rgan rabs sri zhu pha ma'i bkur sti dang*/ /lam mthun glo bur lhags dang nad pa'i tshogs/ /mgon med rnams la phan thogs rgya cher bya/ /sdug phongs rnams la dus su sbyin pa dang*/ /dam pa mchod cing sbyin pa'i sa bon gdab/ /lam gyi stegs dang gru zam 'dzugs pa dang*/ /mgron khang brtsig dang chu rags bzang po dang*/ /zas skom tshul dang phan thog ci 'grub bya/ /lam 'phrang skyel bsu mi 'jigs sbyin pa dang*/ /bya dang ri dwags nya dang 'gro rnams la/ /ri rgya chu rgya mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dang*/ /

gnas mal sbyin sogs skyabs kyi sbyin pa dang*/ /mchod rten lha khang sku gzugs la sogs la/ /phyag dang bskor ba dad pas thal mo sbyar/ /dang bas blta dang gus pas mchod pa dang*/ /rnying pa gso dang zhig ral bcos par bya/ /phyi nang kun tu bzang sems snyoms pa dang*/ /don mthun snyan par smra bas chos la bskul/ /khro dang 'thab rtsod tshig rtsub spangs bya zhing*/ /ci nas gzhan gyi yid dang mthun par bya/ /mi snyan smra la rtsub mo'i lan mi gdab/ /rtag tu khong yangs gze re chung ba dang*/ /gzhan la mi gnod ci 'grub phan gdags shing*/ /g.yo dang zol med rang sems rnam dag bya/ /bzang po'i drin rnams brjed pa med pa dang*/ /phyi thag rgyun ring 'grogs gzhung bsten bya zhing*/ /bya ba kun la rang bzhin brtag pa dang*/ /mtho dman gang la'ang re ba bskyung bar bya/ /'byor ba'i dus su dregs par mi bya la/ /gzhan sems mi dkrugs phrag dog zug rngu spang*/ /'gran sems mi bya chags sdang 'thab rtsod dor/ /khyad du mi bsad zhi des ldan par bya/ /dbul zhing rgud tshe ha cang mi zhum zhing*/ /sngon gyi las brtag gzhan la 'khang mi bya/ /sdig la mi 'jug ngo tsha khrel yod bsten/ /rang tshugs thub pas dge zhing brten par bya/ /chos ldan bde na gzhan du mi 'khyam shing*/ /gang 'dug gnas la rang bzhin brtan par bya/ /chos mi sdug na yul gzhan spo byas pas/ /sngar bas je bder 'gyur pa chos nyid lags/ /mdor na gang snang bde sdug mtho dman kun/ /las su shes nas ngan pa spang ba dang*/ /bzang po sgrub cing ngang rgyud dge bar bya/ /'di dang phyi mar legs pa bsgrub pa lags/ /rang gi sdug bsngal gzhan la mi spo zhing*/ /dang len bzod pas bsran par bya ba dang*/ /thog tu gang babs rang gi las shes pas/ /dgag sgrub btang la legs nyes shes par bya/ /gzhan gyi tshig la bden rdzun brtag bya zhing*/ /kha tar shes pas blang dor dran bya yis/ /khro bar mi bya slar la khong yangs bskyed/

/bzod bya des pas rang rgyud dul bar bya/ /de dag la sogs legs pa'i dngos rnams la/ /chos dang 'jig rten phal cher don mthun pas/ / sngon gyi chos rgyal dam pa de dag dang*/ /skye bo mdzangs pa rnams kyi rjes 'gro bya/ /'di ni rang gzhan yun gyi don srid mchog /phan pa'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi yin gyis nyon/ /'jig rten dge ba can rnams thar pa yi/ /grong khyer mchog tu 'dzegs pa'i them skas mang*/ /de ltar lha mi'i chos lugs legs rtogs nas/ /srid pa'i grong las rab tu 'da' ba'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu zhir 'gro ba/ /thar pa byang chub sgrub la 'bad par bya/ /byang chub rtsa ba sa bon snying rje'i bdag /srid pa na yang bde ba'i 'bras mang zhing*/ /mthar thug gzhal med yon tan yid bzhin gter/ /gzhan don rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bya/ /'di ni bsod nams phung po dpag med de/ /rgyal bas bsngags shing 'jig rten gsum gyis bstod/ /chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab/ /mtha' yas yon tan dpag med tshogs dang ldan/ /gang gis thar pa'i mchog la rab dmigs te/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'gyur zhes smon pa dang*/ /'jug pa'i rang bzhin mngon par sgrub byed na/ /dge ba de 'dra 'jig rten gsum na med/ /byang chub smon pa yongs bzung dag par spel/ /tshad med bzhi la bslab par ston pas gsungs/ /sdug bsngal mang ldan srid pa'i sems can rnams/ /thog mtha' med nas 'khor ba 'dir 'khyams te/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal gyur la rab brtse bas/ /byams pa'i sa gzhir snying rje'i me tog bkram/ /dga' ba'i ljon tshogs btang snyoms mtsho bsil gyi/ /ma lus 'gro la zhi bde'i sems mchog sbyang*/ /'jug pa'i rang bzhin yongs bzung dag pa spel/ /pha rol phyin rnams rim pas bslab par bya/ /phyin drug rang bzhin sum cu rtsa drug las/ /go cha'i sgrub pas sgyu ma bzhin du spyad/ /spyad pa po dang spyad bya'i dngos po dang*/

/yul rnams mi dmigs 'khor gsum dag pa yis/ /byang chub dge ba thar ba'i mchog tu bsngo/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa dam pa yin/ / rnam bcu dbang ldan ngo bo 'khor gyi tshul/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*/ /bsam gtan shes rab thabs stobs smon lam dang*/ /ye shes pha rol phyin bcu re re bzhin/ /bcu bcu rjes 'gro brgya phrag dam pa ni/ / khyad par can dang khyad par med tshul gyi/ /sa rnams kun tu yongs su bsgrub par bya/ /tshogs sbyor mthong sgom pa yi lam bzhi ru/ /dran dang spong bzhi rdzu 'phrul rkang pa bzhi/ /dbang po stobs lnga byang chub yan lag bdun/ /'gas lam brgyad de mnyam rjes spyod yul can/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun bsgom bya/ /gzungs dang ting 'dzin nyi ma rgya che zhing*/ /spyan dang mngon shes 'od zer stong 'phro bas/ /rig pa'i mkha' dbyings dam pas rab brgyan cing*/ /zhi ba'i rnam grol rab tu brtan pa yin/ /gong nas gong du sa rnams rab 'phar zhing*/ /sgrib pa'i mun bral ye shes dbyings la sbyor/ /ting 'dzin yon tan 'bum phrag yangs pa'i chos/ /rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi rjes su 'gro ba lags/ /mthar gyis dag pa gnyis ldan chos sku'i mkhar/ /longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul pas rab brgyan te/ /kun tu 'od zer 'gyed pa'i sa thob nas/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /de phyir byang chub don du gnyer rnams kyis/ / nam gyi cha stod nyid dang cha smad dang*/ /snga dro phyi dro gung rnams rtag brtson pas/ / bsam gtan dang ni 'don la brtson 'grus brtsam/ /mtshan mo'i thun smad gnyid kyis snyoms pa na'ang*/ /sdig zad nyon mongs med yid can gyis nyal/ / ldang tshe rmi lam sdig pa bshags bya zhing*/ /dge bar mthong na yi rang bsngo ba bya/ /dus rnams kun tu mi rtag 'chi dang skye/ /dge dang dkon mchog gsum po dran bya zhing*/ /spyod yul dag pa'i spyod pa rnams sbyang dang*/

/skyes bu chen po'i rnam rtog brgyad dran bya/ /zas kyi tshe na'ang mi gtsang 'gyur ba dang*/ /srin bu'i grong la phan par 'dod pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun rjes dran pas/ /ran par za zhing smon lam rgya cher gdab/ /nyin mtshan kun tu dad pas brtson 'grus brtsam/ /spyod lam kun tu chos kyis 'da' bar bya/ /dus rnams kun tu rang rgyud 'ba' zhig 'dul/ /sems bskyed kun tu gzhan phan 'ba' zhig gis/ /sems can mthong la byams pa'i sems gtsang gis/ /byang chub snying po can zhes gus pa bskyed/ /sku gzugs mchod rten bsod nams zhing rnams la/ /rgyal ba'i byang chub ljon shing dran par bya/ /mkhan po slob dpon bla ma'i gnas dag la/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul dngos su blta bya zhing*/ /chos mdzad rnams la 'phags pa'i dge 'dun du/ /gus pa bskyed la dag snang mos gus bya/ /gzhan skyon mthong na rang snang 'khrul bar bsam/ /yon tan mthong na rjes su yi rang bsgom/ /rang skyon ngan pa mtshang dang yul nas 'don/ /yon tan spel zhing brtson 'grus dpe med brtsam/ /dam par bsten zhing sdig pa'i grogs po spang*/ /dben par gnas shing sbyangs pa'i yi dam blang*/ /thos bsam sgom pas rang gi rgyud sbyangs shing*/ /ci byed dam pa'i chos su 'gro bar bya/ /sems nyid dbyings la lta ba'i rdzong bca' zhing*/ /gnas lugs ngang la mi rtog mnyam par bzhag /phyi nang chos la sgyu mar spyad bya zhing*/ /'od gsal chos sku'i 'bras bu mngon gyur bya/ /'di ltar yul du snang ba'i chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam sgyu ma mig yor sprul pa 'dra/ /dri za'i grong bzhin snang dus rang bzhin med/ /gzung dang gzung yul med pa gsal snang tsam/ /'dzin pa'i sems kyang gzhi rtsa rten med de/ /ngo bo dngos med kha dog dbyibs dang bral/ /mkha' bzhin rnam dag rgya chad phyogs lhung bral/ /don dam bde gshegs snying po'i rang bzhin lags/ /

de ltar gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis med pas/ /mkha' ltar bdag med spros kun zhi ba nyid/ /ma skyes pa dang mi gnas 'gro 'ong med/ /bsam 'das brjod med byang chub sems kyi ngang*/ /zab mo 'phags pa'i spyod yul rig zhi ba/ /bla ma'i lung bzhin mnyam par bzhag par bya/ /de ltar brtson pas nyin mtshan 'da' byas na/ /lam lnga sa bcu rim gyis gong bgrod de/ /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas/ /yon tan tshogs chen lhun grub thob par 'gyur/ /rab bzang skye bo rnams la chos kyi gtam/ /dri med tshangs pa'i rnga chen snyan bsgrags pas/ /'gro kun tshogs gnyis dge ba'i lam zhugs te/ /thar gling byang chub 'byor pa mtha' yas shog /tshul 'di shes bya'i nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /blo gros 'od stong nyin mor byed pa des/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par sbyar/ /dad ldan thar pa 'dod rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /thar pa la skul pa'i rabs zhes bya ba mang du thos pa'i snyan ngag mkhan kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ /'od zer sprin gyi skyed mos tshal gyi nang*/ kun tu bzang po'i khang bzang mchog zla ba chu shel gyis 'tsher ba'i gnas su legs par sbyar ba ni re zhig rdzogs so/ / dge'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) thar pa la skul ba'i rabs zhes bya ba/ -PAGE 368--PAGE 355--PAGE 354-
